ja278:1.1: kimatthamabhisandhāya → kamatthamabhisandhāya (bj) | kamatthamabhisandhāya → kimattha mabhisandhāya (bj: machasaṁ, syā) | Kimattha → kamattha (cck: sī. pī.)
ja278:1.2: dubbhino sabbakāmadadasseva imaṁ → dūbhino sabbakāmadubhasseva idaṁ (bj) | dūbhino → dubahino (bj: machasaṁ, syā) | dubbhino → dūbhino (cck: sī. pī.)
ja278:1.3: sabbakāmadadasseva → sabbakāmaduhasseva (sya-all) | sabbakāmadubhasseva → sabbakāma rahasseva (bj: machasaṁ) | Sabbakāmadadasseva → duhasseva (cck: sī. syā. pī.); rahasseva (cck: ka.)
ja278:2.1: nihanāhetaṁ padasā ca → nīharāsetaṁ padasāva (sya-all) | nīharāsetaṁ → nihanāhetaṁ. ba. nihanātetaṁ (sya-all: sī.)
ja278:2.3: bhiyyo → bhīyo (bj) | pakujjheyyuṁ → pakuṭṭeyyuṁ (sya-all) | Bhiyyo → bhīyo (cck: sī.) | pakuṭṭeyyuṁ → ba. pakujjheyyuṁ (sya-all: sī.)
ja278:3.2: aññepevaṁ → aññaṁpevaṁ (sya-all) | aññepevaṁ → aññampevaṁ (cck: sī. syā. pī.)
